metadata.description: A Claude Skill that checks Free vs. Build vs. Buy before writing non-trivial code, and actually vets what it finds (license, maintenance, security) instead of stopping at star count.

plugins.name: dont-reinvent
plugins.description: Vets whether to build a feature from scratch, use an existing free/open-source solution, or pay for a third-party API/service. Reads the actual LICENSE file, checks maintenance signals, and runs a real dependency vulnerability scan before recommending anything.
